Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents.

2. The writ petition seeks quashing of the F.I.R. dated 18.09.2023 in Case Crime No. 0482 of 2023,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Rath, District- Hamirpur.

sentences.text: Learned AGA has submitted that in the present matter the chargesheet has been submitted against the petitioners, but he is not certain whether cognizance has not been taken thereon or not.

4. In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed of with direction that till cognizance is taken on the police report by the court below, petitioners shall not be arrested pursuant to the impugned F.I.R.
